svg.title: The Amazing Bookantna, Season 2, Issue 01
svg.desc: A comic book cover for Thanawat Ueasiripracha, data engineer in training and Computer Science student at Khon Kaen University. A masked hero in round glasses stands in front of a starburst asking: but does it generalize? A retired hard drive sidekick waves beside them. Cover blurb: Seagate arc complete.

g.text: Data engineer in training. Computer Science
student at Khon Kaen University, Thailand.
BY DAY: builds data pipelines that don't leak.
BY NIGHT: ships tiny tools nobody asked for.
